chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn al-Hakam, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Al-Sarfan is the chief of your dates.

key_terms.الصَّرَفَانُ: A specific variety or type of date, identified here as superior.
key_terms.سَيِّدُ: Chief, master, or best of a group.

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Al-Sarfan dates in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) designates 'Al-Sarfan' as the preeminent variety of dates, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on identifying superior natural provisions (*khasa'is*) for health and sustenance. This classification underscores the practical wisdom found in the Imams' guidance on dietary excellence, where specific agricultural products are recognized for their distinct qualities and benefits within the community.
